entries.comment: Reviewed all 84 risk cards, updated the ratings and mitigation notes, and linked the work needed to manage each risk.
Added Fall test cases, organized the suites and cases on the board, recorded the test results, and linked failed cases to bug-fix tickets.
Rearranged the deployment diagram, added protocol and port labels, and checked the published VP revision 55.

source: User-provided actual hours, recorded and read back from Jira.
allocation: Recorded once on each parent task; no additional subtask worklogs.
